0022600142.text: The Dallas Mavericks (2-2, 3rd in the Southwest and 9th in the West) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West) in the Mavericks' fifth game of the season. Dallas is without Caleb Martin, Dereck Lively II, Naji Marshall, Santi Aldama, and Tarik Biberovic, and Sergio de Larrea is day-to-day with a knee strain and a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Nikola Topic, Otega Oweh, and Thomas Sorber, with Alex Caruso also day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. Dallas lost all three meetings with Oklahoma City in the 2025-26 season, including a 100-87 loss in Dallas on 2026-03-01, so this is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season.
